SELECT
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM main.Laboratory WHERE typeof(TG) = 'integer') AS integer_tg,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM main.Laboratory WHERE TG IS NOT NULL AND typeof(TG) <> 'integer') AS other_tg,

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.ID) AS patient_count
FROM main.Patient AS p
JOIN main.Laboratory AS l ON l.ID = p.ID
WHERE l.TG >= 200
  AND p.Birthday <= DATE('2026-10-09', '-51 years')
LIMIT 1
